input.body:
Dear Landlord,

Re: Flat 17, 113 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ8 6ZZ – ref R/PM016-1

We emailed you on 11 October about the tenant's back/garden door. It is stiff to close, creaks and the hinges look misaligned. We haven't received a reply yet.

We suggest sending one of our contractors to adjust the hinges and fix it if the job is simple. If the work turns out to be bigger, they will quote first and we will come back to you before anything is spent.

Please reply APPROVE to go ahead on that basis, or let us know if you would prefer to deal with it yourself.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

input.body:
Dear Harriet,

Re: Flat 17, 113 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ8 6ZZ – ref R/PM016-1

Thank you for reporting the problem with your back/garden door. We have passed it to your landlord and asked them to approve a contractor visit, and we have sent them a reminder today. We will update you by 16 October, and once it is approved we will arrange a visit around the times you gave us.

One quick question: can you still close and lock the door securely? If at any point it won't lock, please tell us straight away so we can treat it as urgent.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
